title: Compile a fixed finite half-erasure helper into many qubit half-erasures
statement: For each fixed logical dimension d, the source constructs finite encoders and receiver-only decoders whose induced channel approaches d-dimensional half erasure in diamond norm as the qubit blocklength increases. One encoder serves all accepted masks; rejected masks remain explicit failures.

provides: vanishing-error simulation of a finite logical half-erasure channel
assumptions: d fixed before m tends to infinity
zero rate log2(d)/m; no positive-rate helper claim
costs: existence argument via Haar averaging; no efficient code finder claimed
contract.units: diamond norm; qubits and channel uses
contract.obstruction: Removes witness-dependent helper dimension from a channel instance, not the physical or coding cost.

evidence.quote: Every rejected erasure mask is retained as an explicit failure outcome.

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
